clips.title: The story
paras: In the Stonetalon Mountains, Kaela Shadowspear watches the wilderness southwest of Windshear Crag. She coordinates with fellow sentinels as tensions rise and the land suffers new disruptions. Travelers help scout dangerous ground and learn what has corrupted the ancient defenders.

Kaela Shadowspear watches the passes southwest of Windshear Crag. The Horde presses into the Stonetalon Mountains, while goblin operations exploit the land's natural bounty. Working beside the gnome Gaxim Rustfizzle, Kaela tracks threats pushing deeper into night elf ancestral territory.

Violence against nature has stirred the elementals and harmed the forest's ancient guardians. Kaela sends travelers against the raging spirits and seeks the cause of the corruption afflicting the wounded treants who once guarded the Vale. She works to restore peace before the land is scarred beyond repair.
